pelican.prompt: 创建一个HTML，内容是SVG，绘制一个鹈鹕骑自行车的2D动画，不用验证。不调用用任何skills，也不允许联网搜索。
pelican.judge_prompt: This is a screenshot of an SVG animation that was supposed to show a pelican riding a bicycle. Judge only the drawing's structure, not its style. Answer each check with true or false and reply with JSON only, no other text: {"two_wheels_on_ground": two wheels, both resting on the ground and attached to the frame; "frame_connected": frame, fork, handlebar and seat are joined into one bicycle; "rider_on_bike": the pelican sits on or over the bicycle seat; "limbs_plausible": no legs or wings in impossible places (e.g. coming out of the beak, hanging below the wheels), feet near the pedals; "pelican_recognizable": a bird with a long beak and throat pouch; "no_floating_parts": no detached or floating pieces, nothing badly misplaced; "notes": one short sentence}
